summary: 1 blocking finding applies: required-file preflight must preserve prepare-phase state on failure.

items.title: Preflight failure must preserve prepare-phase state
items.rationale: The finding is source-grounded and affects recovery safety: `run-prepare-spec.js` currently deletes preparing flow state before worktree side effects, so the spec must require the preflight to run before that deletion or otherwise preserve the run-id state on failure.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0] cites `flowManager.cleanStaleFlows()`, `flowManager.cleanStalePreparingFlows()`, and `flowManager.deletePreparingFlow(runIdArg)` before `git worktree add`; spec.json R1/R4 and acceptance criteria did not cover preserving preparing state.
